title: Process Crash Recovery & Uncommitted RAM Buffer Window Reconstruction

timeline_analysis.first_detected_symptom: Trace CSV step count (350) exceeds durable chunk step count (288).
timeline_analysis.earliest_verified_deviation: Step loop: Execution severed at step 350 before next chunk flush boundary.

confirmed_root_cause.description: Subprocess terminated with 62 steps held in volatile RAM buffer. Durable chunks commit every 288 steps; steps [288, 350) were uncommitted.

downstream_consequences: Uncommitted data loss window strictly bounded to 62 steps.
Zero leaked steps allowed into official evaluation score aggregation.
